name: Reconnaissance
description: Enumerate targets, map attack surface, gather information without active exploitation.

name: Traffic Analysis
description: Filter, isolate, and extract evidence from captures (PCAP, HTTP, logs, APK).

name: Authentication Testing
description: Test authentication mechanisms, credential handling, session management.

name: Authorization Testing
description: Test access controls, IDOR, BOLA, BFLA, privilege escalation.

name: Input Validation
description: Test injection, XSS, SQLi, SSRF, deserialization, file upload.

name: Cryptography
description: Review crypto usage, key management, TLS, hashing, randomness.

name: Configuration Review
description: Audit configs for misconfigurations, weak defaults, exposure.

name: Exploitation
description: Validate vulnerabilities with authorized, evidence-driven testing.

name: Evidence Collection
description: Collect reproducible evidence: artifact hash, filter, frame numbers, chain of custody.

name: Risk Analysis
description: Derive severity from impact using CVSS as calculation, not label.

name: Remediation
description: Recommend fixes that break attack chain, not just patch symptoms.

name: Retesting
description: Verify fix with same test, capture delta as retest evidence.

name: Reporting
description: Write findings a client can act on: title, impact, evidence, remediation, retest.

name: VAPT Methodology
description: Apply engagement lifecycle: authorization → recon → enum → test → evidence → impact → remediation → retest → report.

name: Wireless Basics
description: Why radio changes threat model: broadcast medium, no physical boundary, layer-1 evidence.

name: SSID/BSSID/ESS
description: Decode SSID, BSSID, ESS, BSS/DS topology from beacons.

name: BSSID Analysis
description: Analyze BSSID, vendor OUI, channel, beacon interval.

name: 802.11 Frames
description: Management/control/data frames, Frame Control type/subtype.

name: RSNE Decoding
description: Read RSNE fields: version, group cipher, pairwise, AKM, RSN capabilities including MFPC/MFPR.

name: WPA2/RSN
description: PMK → PTK → KCK/KEK/TK, M1-M4 exchange, GTK, PMF.

name: WPA3/SAE
description: SAE Dragonfly, forward secrecy, transition mode downgrade, PMF required, OWE.

name: EAP Methods
description: PEAP, EAP-TLS, EAP-TTLS, MS-CHAPv2, credential exposure, cert validation.

name: RADIUS
description: RADIUS protocol mechanics, Message-Authenticator, shared secret, RadSec.

name: Attack Surface
description: Map attack surface across wireless, web, api, mobile, network, cloud, AI.

name: Ethics & Authorization
description: Legal and ethical limits: own lab hardware or signed authorization, never third-party networks.
